content.short: Slingshot is an Ethereum-based DeFi swapping protocol with 0% swap fees.
content.description: Founded in 2020, Slingshot is a DeFi platform that lets you search for, send, receive, and swap more than 50,000 cryptocurrencies at the best prices, with 0% swap fees. Available as a desktop web app and a mobile wallet, Slingshot supports multi-chain use and bridging for Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, Binance BNB Chain, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Ethereum Mainnet, and Canto (bridges coming soon). The project continually adds features and reward-driven participation options for its growing community.
content.meta: Slingshot is an Ethereum-based DeFi app for swapping crypto with 0% swap fees. Discover Slingshot and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
